snippets.snippet_text: "I spent thousands on bud vases that took a month to receive the first batch and another month to receive the second with correct design. DO NOT BUY from LiteSkyscraperStyle!!! His shop says United States but I think he's from London (at least that's what support told me). The shipment came from China. Design was NOTHING like we agreed on the first batch causing the seller to send me a second batch. The packaging was subpar. 20 broken vases in the first batch and 30 in the second. Seller refused to refund me for the broken ones."

"I ordered some stained glass flowers with stems. Although they arrived ahead of the scheduled delivery date the quality was awful and bore little resemblance to the photos when purchased. One of them even fell apart as I unpacked it. I decided that I would need to arrange a refund. This is when the fun and games really started. Unlike every other retail app I have ever used, purchases are not automatically recorded on your account. Despite having taken the trouble to register my details when I set up the app, I had to go through a long rigmarole to link my purchase to my account."

"I want to report my extremely disappointing experiences with Etsy. 1. I purchased a \"Winter\" set including hand gloves, a scarf, and a hat, which was advertised as cashmere but was not. I had to return it. 2. I also purchased items with \"sapphire\" glass stones sold as genuine sapphires, which they clearly were not. Etsy allows sellers to mislead buyers and ignores legitimate complaints. Because of this, I have closed my account and will no longer shop on Etsy."

"I purchased items from a seller that were delivered well beyond the expected delivery time. When they arrived they were damaged due to poor packaging. I contacted seller who said they would refund and then they ghosted me. I got Etsy involved and Etsy cancelled the order and refunded me but also covered the sellers cost. Now I am unable to leave a review on the sellers account? Even though I went three months waiting for this item that was for a wedding. I think that is crazy that future buyers won't be able to see accurate reviews on the seller"
"2026 in February I ordered a necklace with a little bird ( wren). It came from England in no time. All the way through i was informed! The necklace is soo beautiful and I get many comments."

"Used to be handmade items, made with love and care. Now its just a platform for lots of rubbish from China which is incorrectly sized, poor material (unlikely to conform to UK H&S) and awful service. Have to pay through the nose to return items to other countries and no cover for items that go missing. Better off throwing money in the bin."
